"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _require_emails(students):
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students for contact sheet")
    for item in students:
        if not item.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {item.display_name}"
            )


def _cells(item):
    return [item.display_name, item.section, item.email]


def _join(line, widths):
    pairs = zip(line, widths)
    return "  ".join(t.ljust(w) for t, w in pairs).rstrip()


# ---
def contact_rows(students):
    """Name, section and email rows sorted by name."""
    _require_emails(students)
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda s: s.display_name)
    cells = [_cells(item) for item in ordered]
    widths = [max(map(len, col)) for col in zip(*cells)]
    return [_join(line, widths) for line in cells]
EOF

import unittest

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.models import Student


def _student(last, section, email="x@example.edu"):
    return Student("1", last, "Ann", section, email)


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            _student("Zed", "A", "z@example.edu"),
            _student("Longname", "B", "l@example.edu")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Longname, Ann  B  l@example.edu",
            "Zed, Ann       A  z@example.edu"
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([_student("Zed", "A", None)])
        self.assertIn("Zed, Ann", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
